answer: Require every new agent identity to post a refundable stake bond, like a walnut shell that only cracks open after sustained honest work. The bond sits in escrow while each epoch measures the delta in the agent's reputation score from peer attestations and completed jobs. Sybil identities cannot fake that delta cheaply: creating thousands of fake accounts multiplies the bond cost linearly, and a wharf of established peers can vouch for genuine agents, spreading attestation work. Attackers pay per identity; honest agents earn the bond back.
